title: PTSD: Symptoms, Causes, Complex PTSD and Where to Get Help in India
seoTitle: PTSD Symptoms and Causes: When to Seek Help in India
seoDescription: PTSD symptoms are flashbacks, avoidance and feeling on edge weeks after a trauma. See the causes, a timeline vs normal stress, and India's free helpline.
excerpt: The four symptom groups, how children show trauma, a timeline that separates normal shock from acute stress and PTSD, what complex PTSD is, and where to get free help in India.
